messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's action in the source video to the action demonstrated in the motion reference. Transfer only the demonstrated action; do not adopt the reference person's appearance, the reference scene, or the reference camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video, including the person's identity, appearance, scene, lighting, and camera framing.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the person's action to the one demonstrated in the reference video. Transfer only the demonstrated action, not the reference person's appearance or the reference scene and camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"He stands still, then turns his head and body to the left, raises his right hand toward his face, and turns back to face forward.","camera":"A static, medium shot at eye level keeps the man centered in the frame.","clothing":"A white sleeveless tank top with a pink palm-tree graphic and the words “LOS ANGELES” in orange, paired with light blue pants.","hair_color":"Black.","hairstyle":"Short, dark hair with a slightly textured top.","identity":"A young Black man with a slim build and short dark hair stands facing the camera.","scene":"A futuristic, neon-lit plaza with a large glass building, a glowing circular ring, and wet pavement reflecting pink and blue lights."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The source man now performs a new action: he stands, turns his head and body to his left, raises his right hand toward his face, then turns back to face forward. His identity, white Los Angeles tank top, futuristic plaza, lighting, and static medium framing remain consistent with the source.
arguments.requested_change: Transfer only the motion reference's action to the source person, preserving the source person's identity, appearance, scene, lighting, and camera framing.
uncertain: The reference motion includes a head tilt and more pronounced body sway that are not clearly reproduced in the output.
unexpected_changes: The transferred motion appears to use the opposite hand from the reference, which raises the left hand toward the face.
